title: channels__send — output
description: Output schema for the channels__send MCP tool. Returned as soon as the message is durably accepted by the backing store. A successful response guarantees the message is immediately visible to all matching watch loops and subsequent recv calls (backing-store send-atomicity contract). Normative reference: spec/protocol.md and spec/ports/backing-store.md §2.1.

sent_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which the backing store accepted the message. Retained for backward compatibility; seq is the authoritative ordering key within a channel.

message_id.description: Backing-store-assigned unique identifier for the message just sent. Use this as the reply_to value for threaded replies, or as the reference in channels__ack calls.

seq.description: The per-channel sequence number assigned to this message by the server. Per-channel monotone counter starting at 1. Use as the since cursor for replay. See docs/decisions/seq-ordering-scope.md.

backpressure.description: Advisory backpressure signal for the target channel. Always present regardless of backpressure_mode. Senders SHOULD use this to self-throttle in advisory mode. In enforced mode (backpressure_mode: enforced on the channel), the server returns BACKPRESSURE_OVER_LIMIT error instead of a successful response when state is 'over'. See docs/decisions/backpressure-model.md.

queue_depth.description: Current number of undelivered messages in the target channel queue.

threshold.description: Configured queue depth threshold above which state transitions to warn or over. Default: 1000. Per-channel override is configurable.

state.description: Server-computed backpressure state. ok: below threshold. warn: approaching threshold. over: at or above threshold. In enforced backpressure_mode, over causes a BACKPRESSURE_OVER_LIMIT error instead of this response.

metadata.description: Pipeline observability metadata. Always present in dispatched responses; populated by the middleware Pipeline base. Includes pipeline_trace (per-plugin execution trace) and correlation_id (request correlation). Tools and clients MAY ignore metadata; backwards-compatible.

pipeline_trace.description: Per-plugin execution trace. Each entry: {plugin_id, kind, started_at, finished_at, verdict, error_code?, correlation_id}. Verdict ∈ {passed, rejected, errored, skipped}.

correlation_id.description: Request correlation identifier. Echoed from MiddlewareContext.correlation_id (frozen field). UUID4 hex if not provided in input.
